purpose: Source-backed detector parity and same-run Phase171 stop-constraint integration validation.

contract.even_window_rule: centered MATLAB movstd extra sample is previous/current side: left=k/2, right=(k-1)/2
contract.singleton_window_rule: sample-standard-deviation singleton is zero; empty window remains invalid
contract.tie_policy: preceding sample is an explicit native deterministic policy; MATLAB tie equivalence is not claimed

implementation.app_fix: The legacy Phase93 frozen-recipe rejection of upstream stop constraints now applies only when Phase171 is not selected; Phase171 staging remains raw-P-only and the stop selector is consumed by the Pose3+IMU main config.

coverage: stop selector off control with slow same-run handoff
quiet IMU plus optimized slow (<0.5 m/s) stage seed inserts 2 velocity and 1 pose stop factors
optimized fast stage seed suppresses stop factors
nonfinite IMU fails closed before graph admission
even-window asymmetric impulses at k=2,4,500 and odd-window regression
singleton endpoint standard deviation is zero
